description: Wire the per-document probe into the production in-process pipeline. process_document runs probe_document_images ONCE over the already-supplied in-memory page images when settings.probe_enabled is True and at least one page needs probing; process_page consumes page_context['probe'] at the existing seam, builds a single-task plan from the probe route (used directly as the engine), records the probe dict in PageMetadata.extra['probe'], and skips the dormant _maybe_probe_route for probed pages. Flag OFF stays byte-identical. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (probe_document_images, the settings flag, and the magic-byte VLM fix must already exist).
steps: process_document (src/ai/layer1_routing/pipeline.py): BEFORE the page loop, add a guarded block 'if settings.probe_enabled:'. For each page_data compute profile = inspect_page(page_data['page'], page_data['page_number']) and given_route = route_from_profile(profile) (None allowed), then cfg = ProbeConfig.from_env() and decide needs = probe.needs_probe(profile.model_dump(), given_route, cfg). Collect the page_numbers that need probing and their images from page_data['context']['image_array'] (fallback: decode page_data['image_bytes']). If ANY page needs probing, wrap the probe call in try/except.

process_document probe deps (mockable): add a small module-level helper _build_probe_deps(cfg) returning (vlm, onnx) where vlm = BedrockScriptProbe(model_id=cfg.vlm_model_id, region=cfg.vlm_region) when cfg.vlm_enabled and cfg.vlm_model_id else None, and onnx = inprocess._get_observer() (the existing singleton, swappable in tests via inprocess._OBSERVER). Tests monkeypatch _build_probe_deps so no real Bedrock/boto/onnx loads.

process_document probe call + attach: decisions = probe.probe_document_images(images, page_numbers, profiles={pn: profile_dict}, cfg=cfg, vlm=vlm, onnx=onnx). On success, for each probed page whose PageProbe is routable (status not 'not_needed'), set page_data['context']['probe'] = {'route': pp.route, 'ocr_lang': pp.ocr_lang, 'script': pp.script, 'script_confidence': pp.script_confidence, 'handwriting_prob': pp.handwriting_prob, 'has_table': pp.has_table, 'is_blank': pp.is_blank, 'route_reason': pp.route_reason}. Pages marked not_needed/digital get NO 'probe' key. On ANY exception: logger.error('probe.failed', document_id=document_id, error=str(exc)) and attach NO 'probe' keys (every page falls back to today's routing); never abort the document. Do NOT re-render, do NOT touch S3.

process_page (src/ai/layer1_routing/pipeline.py) seam at ~lines 444-453: replace the current 'if primary_task is not None: _choice = _maybe_probe_route(...)' block with: 'if "probe" in page_context:' -> primary_task = EngineTask(engine=page_context['probe']['route'], priority=1, reason=f"probe:{page_context['probe'].get('route_reason','')}"); plan = [primary_task]; if page_context['probe'].get('ocr_lang'): page_context['ocr_lang'] = page_context['probe']['ocr_lang']; metadata.extra['probe'] = dict(page_context['probe']); (SKIP _maybe_probe_route for this page). 'else:' keep the EXISTING _maybe_probe_route block UNCHANGED (including the primary_task is not None guard and the IDP_ENABLE_PROBE gate). Use probe.route DIRECTLY as the engine (do NOT remap through _ROUTE_TO_ENGINE). A 'skip' route flows through the existing skip engine. The escalation ladder below is unchanged.

NEW integration test file tests/test_pipeline_probe_document.py reusing patterns from tests/test_pipeline_probe_integration.py (StubLLM; FakeObserver via inprocess._OBSERVER; monkeypatch pipeline.inspect_page to yield controlled PageProfiles; monkeypatch scanned._invoke_paddle_lambda to capture the payload; monkeypatch pipeline._build_probe_deps to inject a StubVLM + fake/None onnx so no Bedrock/boto). Build 'pages' lists of page_data dicts each with context={image_array, image_bytes}, page, page_number, image_bytes. Cover every case listed in acceptance_criteria.
Run the full fast suite excluding the real-engine local tests and the slow real-model test; confirm green and record before/after counts for the report.
acceptance_criteria: flag OFF: no 'probe' key attached, _maybe_probe_route path unchanged, metadata.extra has no 'probe'; existing tests/test_pipeline_probe_integration.py still passes.
flag ON, scanned Latin printed page: plan is ONE paddleocr_printed task and the captured mocked Lambda payload has ocr_lang == 'en'.
flag ON, VLM returns latin + handwriting_prob 0.9 (confident-latin extra-VLM path): page routes to paddleocr_handwritten.
flag ON, non-Latin (telugu/devanagari): page routes to vlm_transcribe and the escalation ladder is NOT re-entered (escalation_attempts == 0, no second engine run).
flag ON, blank page: engine is 'skip' and the page is skipped.

MIXED DOCUMENT (digital + printed scan + blank + table scan): per-page selected engines are docling, paddleocr_printed, skip, paddleocr_printed respectively, with use_structure only RECORDED in extra['probe'] (not acted on); assert engines differ per page.
HETEROGENEOUS DOCUMENT (sampled pages disagree): VLM probe call count exceeds n_samples (widening via additional_sample_pages) and non-sampled pages inherit the nearest sample's route.
probe RAISES (monkeypatch probe.probe_document_images to throw): every page falls back to today's routing, 'probe.failed' is logged, and the document completes with all pages present.
digital pages are never probed (no 'probe' key; needs_probe False) and their output is unchanged.
BOTH flags on (IDP_ENABLE_PROBE and probe_enabled): the new per-document probe wins and pipeline._maybe_probe_route is NOT called for probed pages (asserted via a spy/monkeypatch with 0 calls).
VLM probe call count per document is ~= n_samples (3) in the sampling tests (counted explicitly).
Full fast suite is green excluding tests/test_layer2_engines_local.py::*_engine_local_path and @pytest.mark.slow; after-count == before-count + new tests from FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Edited ONLY src/ai/layer1_routing/pipeline.py + new tests/test_pipeline_probe_document.py (scanned.py/settings.py/probe.py were already done in FEAT-001; not touched).

PIPELINE CHANGES:
(1) Added module-level _build_probe_deps(cfg) -> (vlm, onnx): vlm = BedrockScriptProbe(model_id=cfg.vlm_model_id, region=cfg.vlm_region) when cfg.vlm_enabled and cfg.vlm_model_id else None; onnx = inprocess._get_observer(). Lazy imports inside the fn so flag-OFF pays zero import cost; tests monkeypatch it.
(2) Added _run_document_probe(pages, document_id): per page runs inspect_page + route_from_profile; TRANSLATES the Layer-1 route vocab (digital/scanned/skip/None) to probe engine-name vocab via _ROUTE_TO_ENGINE BEFORE calling probe.needs_probe (critical: needs_probe compares given_route against 'docling'/'skip', not 'digital'). Collects page images from context['image_array'] (fallback context['image_bytes'] then page_data['image_bytes']). Calls probe.probe_document_images ONCE. On success attaches context['probe']={route,ocr_lang,script,script_confidence,handwriting_prob,has_table,is_blank,route_reason} to routable probed pages (status != 'not_needed'); on ANY exception logs 'probe.failed' and attaches nothing (every page falls back). Never re-renders, never touches S3, never aborts.
(3) process_document: added 'if settings.probe_enabled: _run_document_probe(pages, document_id)' BEFORE the serial/parallel page dispatch. Flag OFF = no-op = byte-identical.
(4) process_page seam (~line 448): new 'if "probe" in page_context:' branch builds a single EngineTask using probe['route'] DIRECTLY as the engine (NOT via _ROUTE_TO_ENGINE), sets page_context['ocr_lang'] from probe when present, records metadata.extra['probe']=dict(probe), and SKIPS _maybe_probe_route. The 'elif primary_task is not None:' branch is the ORIGINAL dormant per-page hook, unchanged. Escalation ladder below unchanged.
